subject: FVD workstream kickoff — one metric for video gen
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kickoff for the Fréchet Video Distance workstream. FVD gives us a single number for generative video quality: we embed real and generated clips with an I3D network (preprocessed to 224x224, loaded via tensorflow-hub) and compute the Fréchet distance between the two embedding distributions. Every video-gen effort in the vision portfolio is currently rolling its own eval, and I want FVD as the standard gate.

Milestones: metric library integrated with two internal model repos by Mar 13, variance and calibration study through the spring, and a large calibration sweep in early June so scores are comparable across model families before Q3 OKRs.

Quentin, Katya and Tereza are assigned. Daniela — staffing and compute plan when you can.

Best,
Lucia
